AT-08_scope: All plain-text extensions .txt .csv .log .json .xml receive explicit text MIME and extension hints and skip triage. Successful conversions use row 11; backend failures still use rows 4-5.
kind: slice-3 API characterization; not an OCR report

observations.adapter_resolution: When charset is explicit, also pass StreamInfo(charset=charset). This fulfills DESIGN r9's effective-charset requirement without changing input bytes or the extension.
observations.explanation: convert_local builds StreamInfo without copying kwargs['charset']; PlainTextConverter reads stream_info.charset. The long Slice 1 CP949 fixture decoded correctly through autodetection, not because the bare keyword was effective.
observations.source: runtime-generated plain.txt containing CP949 bytes b0a1 (가)

observations.explanation: With no text MIME guess and no StreamInfo charset, .log is not accepted by PlainTextConverter on this host. A bare charset keyword does not change that eligibility. Other hosts may have a text MIME mapping.
observations.source: runtime-generated plain.log containing Synthetic log 123 followed by LF

slice3_portability_resolution.backend_policy: Disable automatic built-in registration; register only the document backend selected by the allow-listed extension. Sniffed audio cannot reach optional audio or ExifTool backends.
slice3_portability_resolution.fixture_checkout: tests/fixtures/** -text in .gitattributes preserves exact bytes and existing digests.
slice3_portability_resolution.historical_observations: The entries above describe the previous adapter and remain historical; .log without charset is now always text-only/ready.
slice3_portability_resolution.plain_text_hint: Always pass StreamInfo(extension=ext, mimetype=text/plain, charset=effective_or_None) for .txt .csv .log .json .xml; preserve the actual charset in activity.params.
